responsibility: This header declares the broad C API for gm2 expression lowering. It exposes builders for arithmetic and logical trees, checked operations, comparisons, set manipulation and membership tests, calls into generic binary/unary constructors, literal parsing, constant comparison, array/component/pointer access, size queries, and initialization of expression support, matching the implementation responsibilities of m2expr.cc.
same_name_distinction: C/C++ header for the m2expr group: it declares the native callable expression-building functions and callback signatures, while m2expr.def provides the Modula-2-side foreign specification and m2expr.cc implements the actual tree-building behavior.
